svg.title: We identify those six contributions in terms of the finite functions, to avoid ambiguity between this split and the six antisymmetric tensor differences in (TF0d). At the current scale let Yb be the localized current, eJ the restored tensor, PA the finite principal action, and LQ the finite ordinary loop sum. Write QQ for its augmented quiet sum, with the zero and first path moments removed as in (TF6a)–(TF6c).
